name: queryAddRow
description: Adds rows to a query, either empty row(s) or you can add a row with data

params.name: numberOrData
params.description:
Number of rows to add to the query or a struct/array containing the data to populate the row.

Examples:

- ```queryAddRow(qry, 3);```
- ```queryAddRow(qry, [ "Susi", 20] );```
- ```queryAddRow(qry, { name: "Susi", age: 20 } );```
